traits.name: Incorporeal Passage (Ectoplasmic Entity and Ghostly Entity Only)
traits.descriptionHtml: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If the spirit ends its turn in such a space, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.
entries: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. If the spirit ends its turn in such a space, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 1d10} Force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).
entries: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Crystal Strike (Crystal Entity Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Attack: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level Piercing damage.
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 3} + the spell's level Piercing damage.

actions.name: Ectoplasmic Splash (Ectoplasmic Entity Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Attack: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 30 feet. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level Psychic damage. Hit or Miss: Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from and including the target has its Speed reduced by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 30 feet. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 3} + the spell's level Psychic damage. {@hom}Each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from and including the target has its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Ephemeral Ray (Ghostly Entity Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Ranged Attack: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 120 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Psychic damage.
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 120 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3} + the spell's level Psychic damage.

reactions.name: Shard Swarm (Crystal Entity Only)
reactions.descriptionHtml: {@actTrigger} The spirit is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} The spirit halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack. The spirit can then teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself.
entries: {@actTrigger} The spirit is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} The spirit halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack. The spirit can then teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself.
